stories.title: Policing to be reorganised into 200 local commands, each with a named commander
stories.summary: Policing across England and Wales is to be reorganised into around 200 Local Police Commands, each led by a named commander, the Home Secretary has announced. stories.title: Social care delays keep Flintshire patients in hospital
stories.summary: Ninety-two Flintshire residents were in hospital in July waiting to go home, even though they were well enough to leave, a council report shows. stories.title: Fraudsters posing as police cybercrime officers target cryptocurrency in North Wales
stories.summary: Cryptocurrency holders in Flintshire and across North Wales are being warned about fraudsters who phone pretending to be police cybercrime officers.
